verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Decagon uses past customer interactions to auto-generate AOPs (decagon-docs-6), and it drafts help-center content from how human agents resolved issues (decagon-docs-10). That implies it is connected to both past tickets and the help center. Integrations are said to let the agent retrieve data with no custom code (decagon-docs-33), but nothing explicitly describes ingesting help-center articles, docs, or internal wikis as grounding knowledge sources. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of help-center/doc/wiki connectors for knowledge ingestion, evidence that existing content is used as-is without re-authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
